label: AbiJ system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an AbiJ-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder AbiJ model namespace and mandatory AbiJ__AbiJ profile.
observations: AbiJ branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual AbiJ__AbiJ profiles, the abiJ gene, unresolved HEPN-domain predictions, AbiA escape-mutant routes, individual phage escape mutations, source database rows naming one AbiJ model, and generic abortive infection systems.
